purpose: Deterministic replay of the single WP50D static_unserialised fault (seed 50801734) under the owned worker and the unserialised dispatch, to classify it; plus a chain-2 trace for transitions 0..9 and a check of how the error reached the child.
seed_note: deliberate reuse: the replay seed is the WP50D faulting child's seed
library_code: unchanged; child/ is built against this worktree HEAD with owalnuts features=[research] (needed for Sampler::run_with_comparison_observers and NonfinitePositionPolicy)

launcher.environment: registry Machine;User PATH, Git Bash variables removed (as WP50D)

C_wp50d_original.role: fidelity check: the byte-identical WP50D child exe, arm static_unserialised, seed 50801734, no observers

D_owned_reject.role: descriptive: does research RejectLeaf turn the abort into a completed run

ordering_note: strictly sequential, one process at a time, 4 threads; each process in its own run; exe-only launch dirs build/arms/<v5_owned|v5_unserialised|wp50d>/

tracing.proposal_observer: every proposal observation of every chain is hashed (FNV-1a over transition, target_call, phase/direction/level/leaf/micro_steps/outcome, step, coordinates, gradient, mid-step momentum, kinetic, potential, H) into a per-chain stream hash and count; chain 2 observations for transitions 0..9 are stored in full (values and IEEE bits)
tracing.comparison_observer: chain 2 completed transitions 0..9: selected theta (with bits), selected rho, log density, gradient, diagnostics, work, leaf outcomes, adaptation (step before/after)
tracing.target_wrapper: pass-through target counting calls, nonfinite inputs, recoverable/fatal TargetErrors and nonfinite values returned
tracing.passivity: observers and wrapper do not alter the sampler state; arm C (original WP50D exe, no observers, no research feature) checks that the replayed event is the WP50D event

classification.reproduced_v5: status == sampler_error AND error.kind == Numerical AND error.display contains 'kernel attempted a nonfinite target position' AND error.chain == 2 AND error.transition == 9
classification.reproduced_wp50d_exe: launcher rc == 1 AND stderr contains 'kernel attempted a nonfinite target position (chain 2, transition 9)'
classification.stream_identity: the chain-2 stream (observation count, stream hash, last target call, first KernelNonfinite observation) and the starts are identical across all six gating replays
classification.crash: any nonzero NTSTATUS-like rc, timeout, missing output, or Application Error Event 1000 for an arm exe within a child's launch window; reported, and any crash in a gating arm makes the verdict NOT_ESTABLISHED

verdict_rule.DETERMINISTIC_DISPATCH_INDEPENDENT: all 6 gating replays (A x3, B x3) reproduced_v5 AND stream_identity holds AND no crash: the fault is a deterministic sampler/target event independent of dispatch, and the WP50D static arm's native-fault count is 0/1000 by construction
verdict_rule.NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNSERIALISED_ONLY: B reproduces in all 3 and A in none
verdict_rule.NOT_ESTABLISHED_NONDETERMINISTIC: any other pattern (mixed reproduction, stream differences across replays, or a crash)
verdict_rule.fidelity_note: if arm C does not reproduce 3/3 the verdict is still computed as above, and the mismatch is reported as an anomaly that limits the transfer to WP50D

integration_question.not_an_integration_bug: error.kind == Numerical AND has_target_source == false AND target_layer.nonfinite_inputs == 0 in every reproducing replay: the kernel aborted under the shipped NonfinitePositionPolicy::Abort before calling the target, so no TargetError existed for the Replicated target to surface
integration_question.possible_integration_bug: error.kind == Target, a target_source present, or nonfinite inputs reached the target layer: reported as a candidate integration bug
